findings.excerpt: Let C_sm be their smooth concordance classes ... Let C_top be their locally flat topological concordance classes ... Let C_ex be their exotic-smooth concordance classes ... For a nonzero integer n set R_n=Z[1/|n|].
findings.symptom: The definition uses unmarked ASCII notation throughout the displayed prose: underscores, carets, set brackets, and homology subscripts remain baseline text instead of mathematical notation (for example C_sm, S^3, R_n, and H_i).
findings.suggested_repair: Mark the mathematical expressions in the definition with the repository’s math delimiters so subscripts, superscripts, and symbols render consistently.

findings.symptom: The local HTML and screenshot expose the full TikZ source as ordinary body text rather than rendering the braid diagram. The following explanatory prose still appears after the source dump.
findings.suggested_repair: Use a TikZ block form supported by the renderer, or author an equivalent supported diagram, then confirm the six crossings and pure-braid endpoint labels render.

findings.symptom: The local preview displays a red “diagram failed to render” panel followed by the raw TikZ-cd source, so the movie diagram is absent.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair the diagram block so it uses a renderer-supported diagram environment and renders the birth map followed by the merging saddle map.

findings.symptom: The second, cusp-strip TikZ diagram fails in the local preview and is replaced by a red error panel containing raw source. The preceding two-tetrahedron drawing does render.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair or simplify the cusp-strip TikZ so the eight triangle labels, successive face maps, and alpha/beta paths render; retain the existing explanatory schematic disclaimer.

findings.symptom: Several proof paragraphs contain unmarked ASCII mathematical notation, so the local render shows literal forms such as V=[[0,I+U],[U^T,0]], “one0handle,” T_ik, lambda(...), and delta_ij rather than formatted mathematics.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the algebraic expressions and indexed symbols in the affected proof paragraphs; retain the prose around each construction.

diagram_candidates.content: Show the oriented peripheral torus with the three primitive slopes s_0, s_1, s_∞ pairwise intersecting once; label the fillings Y_0, Y_1, Y_∞ and the directed 2-handle cobordisms Y_0→Y_1→Y_∞→Y_0.
checks: Each slope pair has geometric intersection number one.
The determinant orientation convention matches det(v_0,v_1)=det(v_1,v_∞)=det(v_∞,v_0)=1.
The three cobordism arrows follow the exact cyclic order stated in line 41.
This is optional explanatory context; the definition does not claim the Floer exact triangle.
